card.name: Time expressions after at, by, in
card.fires_on: The word or number that starts a date or clock time right after a preposition such as at, by or in. Examples are 'end' of the year, 'late' before a month or year, and the first digit of a clock time.

modes.label: End or late of a period
modes.description: The words 'end' or 'late' after at, by or in, before a year or month.
modes.example: are set to be released by the<< end>> of the year.

modes.label: Clock time or day number
modes.description: The space or first digit just before a time of day or a numbered day or month.

modes.label: Year after by
modes.description: The position just before a target year after 'by'.
modes.example: Vietnam to build space centre by<< >>2018 - Nov 1

card.writes: It appears to push the model toward the next part of a date or time, such as a season or year, while suppressing Chinese phrases for 'time is' or 'will be held on'.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is about to give a specific time or date, such as 'by the end of' or 'at 6:00'.
